source_lines_after.text: [F1] *def-axiom-of-choice.* The **Axiom of Choice** (AC) is the following statement. Every family of nonempty sets has a choice function (def-choice-function). Written out: for every set $\mathcal{F}$ all of whose members are nonempty, there exists a function $g$ with domain $\mathcal{F}$ satisfying $g(S) \in S$ for all $S \in \mathcal{F}$. ([[def-axiom-of-choice]])
